scored_rules.title: 价税合计应等于金额与税额之和
scored_rules.note: The arithmetic identity is tested on CORD money values; discounts/service lines are excluded by receipt selection.

scored_rules.title: 同一文件不应重复上传
scored_rules.note: The shipped fileLink check also verifies sourceFile existence, so this rule fires on the missing-original variant alongside INV-024. Labels follow the shipped behavior.

scored_rules.title: 金额与税率应在合理范围
scored_rules.note: Only the total branch is measured; CORD has no taxRate. The large-amount branch is not tested because the profile threshold is CNY and CORD amounts are IDR.

scored_rules.title: 台账行应有原件，输入文件应有归属
scored_rules.note: The missing-original variant is synthetic; the clean variants use the real public JPEG.

coverage_observation.note: Rules with provided=false, zero skipped entries and zero unsupported entries were counted as executed by the plugin even though no required field was present. INV-001 also has no data but still emits an absence finding.

limitations: CORD-v2 is an Indonesian receipt dataset, not a Chinese VAT invoice corpus. Its gt_parse has menu lines, sub_total and total only: no invoice code/number, issue date, buyer, seller, tax rate, form number, reimburser, remark, red-letter marker or line tax. Rules needing those fields are marked not provided and excluded from P/R; no values were invented.

Only 20 of 100 test receipts were selected, and they are the first receipts for which all three money fields exist and |amount + tax - total| <= 0.02 after 2-decimal rounding. Selection is about arithmetic consistency, not about invoice semantics.

CORD has three-decimal money in some receipts and IDR amounts while the shipped rule pack profile is CNY. The adapter normalises values to 2-decimal cents; the plugin does not use the currency field, so only numeric branches are exercised. The large-amount branch (1,000,000) is not tested because it would be meaningless for IDR amounts.

sourceFile and sha256 are derived from the public JPEGs, not from gt_parse. The missing-original variant is synthetic. The shipped fileLink check verifies sourceFile existence in both INV-007 and INV-024, so both are labelled for that defect.
INV-001 emits 发票号码为空 for every CORD row because CORD has no invoice number. Those findings are reported in the raw output but are not a labelled CORD defect and are excluded from P/R.

The duplicate probe duplicates a clean row, but INV-005 cannot detect it: the plugin keys rows as "|" when invoiceCode/invoiceNumber are absent. The probe is reported as unscorable, not as a plugin pass or fail.
CORD has no date at all, so future-date and age/period rules (INV-002, INV-017, INV-018) cannot be scored and no date was fabricated.
The plugin reports some rules as executed even when their required fields are blank (see coverage observation). "executed" is not evidence that a rule was measured on this corpus.
This benchmark measures the rule engine on gold annotations, not OCR/extraction quality. It also does not test the plugin workbook or markdown rendering beyond the tool call succeeding.
